platforms.name: ADP
platforms.discovery_method: Hostname workforcenow.adp.com / myjobs.adp.com & cid parameter inspection
platforms.extraction_method: ADP WorkforceNow Career Center JSON endpoint (/mascsr/default/careercenter/public/events/staffing/v1/job-requisitions)
platforms.auth_requirements: None for public tenant career centers (requires tenant cid & ccId)
platforms.known_limitations: Requires extracting tenant cid and ccId parameters per employer portal; aggressive WAF throttling on rapid pagination.

platforms.name: ApplicantPro
platforms.extraction_method: Public HTML listing + schema.org JobPosting JSON-LD / XML feed
platforms.known_limitations: Many SMB boards protect HTML endpoints behind Cloudflare managed challenges unless XML feed is enabled.

platforms.name: Ashby
platforms.discovery_method: URL jobs.ashbyhq.com/{slug} or embedded ashby_job_board script
platforms.extraction_method: Official Public Posting JSON API (https://api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/{slug}?includeCompensation=true)

verification_evidence.notes: Verified live against https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/tldr.tech (5 normalized jobs).

platforms.known_limitations: Returns all active public postings in a single JSON payload; compensation fields depend on employer visibility settings.

platforms.name: Avature
platforms.extraction_method: Portal RSS/XML feed (/SearchJobs/feed) or paginated HTML portal extraction
platforms.known_limitations: Highly customized enterprise DOM templates per tenant; /SearchJobs/feed availability varies by customer configuration.

platforms.name: BambooHR
platforms.extraction_method: Public Career Portal JSON API (GET https://{slug}.bamboohr.com/careers/list + /careers/{id}/detail)

verification_evidence.notes: Verified live against https://elasticpath.bamboohr.com/careers (3 normalized jobs).

platforms.known_limitations: Full HTML description requires secondary detail request (/careers/{id}/detail) when list endpoint returns summary metadata only.

platforms.name: BrassRing
platforms.extraction_method: Infinite BrassRing TGnewUI SearchJobs JSON POST API with session cookie
platforms.auth_requirements: Public CSRF/session token initialized from landing page
platforms.known_limitations: Requires per-partner partnerid and siteid query parameters plus session state token.

platforms.name: Breezy HR
platforms.extraction_method: Public JSON Feed (https://{slug}.breezy.hr/json) with optional detail JSON-LD enrichment

verification_evidence.notes: Verified live against https://ishir.breezy.hr/ (10 normalized jobs).

platforms.known_limitations: Public /json endpoint omits full body HTML on some portals; connector enriches description via detail JSON-LD when needed.

platforms.name: CSOD
platforms.extraction_method: Cornerstone OnDemand Career Site JSON search endpoint
platforms.auth_requirements: CSRF token from initial career site page load
platforms.known_limitations: Requires tenant career site numeric ID and short-lived anti-forgery token.

platforms.name: CareerPlug
platforms.extraction_method: Public HTML career board + JobPosting JSON-LD
platforms.known_limitations: No documented unauthenticated JSON list API; relies on structured HTML/JSON-LD extraction.

platforms.name: Comeet
platforms.discovery_method: URL comeet.com/jobs/{slug}/{uid} or embedded comeet.co/careers-api widget
platforms.extraction_method: Comeet Public Careers API v2 (/careers-api/2.0/company/{uid}/positions?token={public_token}) or embedded COMPANY_POSITIONS_DATA
platforms.auth_requirements: Public widget token embedded on employer career page
platforms.known_limitations: Direct API requires public company UID and widget token scraped from hosted career page.

platforms.name: Dayforce
platforms.extraction_method: Dayforce HCM Candidate Portal Next.js / JSON search API
platforms.known_limitations: Protected by WAF bot heuristics on high-frequency requests.

platforms.name: Deel
platforms.extraction_method: Public career board JSON / Ashby-backed integration where configured
platforms.auth_requirements: Public career page or partner API token
platforms.known_limitations: Deel ATS public career URLs vary by customer custom domain.

platforms.name: Dover
platforms.extraction_method: Dover public careers portal JSON / Next.js hydration payload
platforms.known_limitations: Uses UUID-keyed organization identifiers on custom domains.

platforms.name: Eightfold AI
platforms.extraction_method: PCSX Career Portal JSON API (/api/apply/v2/jobs) when authorized or public career page
platforms.auth_requirements: Portal session / PCSX referer validation on select tenants
platforms.known_limitations: Many enterprise tenants enforce PCSX session/origin authorization returning HTTP 403 to direct API calls.

platforms.name: FirstStage
platforms.extraction_method: Public HTML / embedded JSON job listings
platforms.known_limitations: Small public footprint; no standardized public REST specification.

platforms.name: Freshteam
platforms.extraction_method: Public Jobs Widget JSON (/hire/widgets/jobs.json) or HTML board
platforms.known_limitations: Freshworks has sunset standalone Freshteam for some tiers; active portals remain on *.freshteam.com/jobs.

platforms.name: Gem.com
platforms.extraction_method: Official Public Job Board JSON API (https://api.gem.com/job_board/v0/{slug}/job_posts)

verification_evidence.notes: Verified live against https://jobs.gem.com/nominal (25 normalized jobs).

platforms.known_limitations: Returns complete active job list with HTML descriptions, locations, and employment types in one payload.

platforms.name: GoHire
platforms.extraction_method: Public career page HTML + JSON-LD JobPosting
platforms.known_limitations: No documented unauthenticated JSON feed; uses SSR HTML pages.

platforms.name: Greenhouse
platforms.discovery_method: URL boards.greenhouse.io/{slug}, job-boards.greenhouse.io/{slug}, gh_jid param, or Greenhouse embed script
platforms.extraction_method: Official Public Job Board API v1 (https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/{slug}/jobs?content=true)

verification_evidence.notes: Verified live against https://boards.greenhouse.io/pelago (15 normalized jobs).

platforms.known_limitations: Pay transparency ranges appear in metadata/content HTML rather than standardized numeric fields on older boards.

platforms.name: HiBob
platforms.extraction_method: HiBob Public Career Site JSON API (/api/career-site/job-ad)
platforms.auth_requirements: None for public HiBob Hiring portals
platforms.known_limitations: Requires custom tenant subdomain on *.careers.hibob.com.

platforms.name: HireBridge
platforms.discovery_method: Hostname recruit.hirebridge.com / jobs.hirebridge.com with cid parameter
platforms.extraction_method: Public XML/RSS feed or HTML portal listing by cid
platforms.known_limitations: Requires numeric employer cid query parameter.

platforms.name: HireHive
platforms.extraction_method: HireHive Public Jobs API (/api/v1/jobs) or HTML + JSON-LD
platforms.known_limitations: Custom domains require HTML signature inspection to determine tenant slug.

platforms.name: Hireology
platforms.extraction_method: Hireology public careers API / HTML + JSON-LD
platforms.known_limitations: Multi-location franchise organizations often split listings across sub-accounts.

platforms.name: HiringThing
platforms.extraction_method: Public RSS/Atom feed or HTML job board
platforms.auth_requirements: None for public RSS/HTML; REST API requires partner key
platforms.known_limitations: White-labeled OEM instances hide hiringthing.com domain unless inspected via DOM.

platforms.name: JOIN.com
platforms.extraction_method: Next.js __NEXT_DATA__ / JobPosting JSON-LD on public company pages
platforms.known_limitations: Strict anti-bot WAF on high-volume unauthenticated scraping.

platforms.name: JazzHR
platforms.extraction_method: Public Career Portal HTML listing + schema.org JobPosting JSON-LD detail extraction

verification_evidence.notes: Verified live against https://betterrx.applytojob.com/apply (4 normalized jobs).

platforms.known_limitations: Appends transient &gsessionid tokens to URLs which must be stripped during canonicalization.

platforms.name: Jobvite
platforms.extraction_method: Public Career Portal HTML / XML feed + JobPosting JSON-LD
platforms.known_limitations: Category-grouped DOM layouts vary significantly across enterprise themes.

platforms.name: Kula.ai
platforms.extraction_method: Kula ATS public career board JSON / SSR data
platforms.known_limitations: Newer ATS platform; custom domains require script inspection.

platforms.name: Lever.co
platforms.extraction_method: Official Public Postings JSON API v0 (https://api.lever.co/v0/postings/{slug}?mode=json)

verification_evidence.notes: Verified live against https://jobs.lever.co/sep (7 normalized jobs).

platforms.known_limitations: Supports skip/limit pagination; EU customers may use jobs.eu.lever.co / api.eu.lever.co.

platforms.name: Manatal
platforms.extraction_method: Public Career Page REST API (https://www.careers-page.com/api/v1.0/c/{slug}/jobs/)

verification_evidence.notes: Verified live against https://www.careers-page.com/bridgepoint-works (12 normalized jobs).

platforms.known_limitations: Paginated via ?page=N; some custom-hosted Manatal subdomains use UUID job paths.

platforms.name: Oracle Recruiting
platforms.extraction_method: Oracle HCM Cloud Public REST API (/hcmRestApi/resources/latest/recruitingCEJobRequisitions)
platforms.auth_requirements: None for public Candidate Experience sites (requires siteNumber parameter)
platforms.known_limitations: Requires extracting tenant siteNumber (e.g., CX_1) from candidate experience bootstrap config.

platforms.name: PageUp
platforms.extraction_method: PageUp Public RSS/JSON feed or career portal HTML
platforms.known_limitations: Regional data residency domains (.com, .com.au, .co.uk) must be preserved.

platforms.name: Paradox
platforms.discovery_method: Hostname olivia.paradox.ai or Paradox conversational career sites
platforms.extraction_method: Paradox career site JSON search API / sitemap + JobPosting JSON-LD
platforms.auth_requirements: None for public job search portals
platforms.known_limitations: Conversational chat-only widgets without public job search boards do not expose enumerable listings.

platforms.name: Paycom
platforms.extraction_method: Paycom ATS Career Portal HTML + JobPosting JSON-LD
platforms.known_limitations: Strict bot protection on rapid sequential detail requests.

platforms.name: Paycor
platforms.extraction_method: Paycor Recruiting Newton career HTML / RSS feed
platforms.known_limitations: Legacy Newton iframe embeds require extracting clientId from parent career page.

platforms.name: Paylocity
platforms.extraction_method: Embedded window.pageData JSON object on public recruiting board
platforms.known_limitations: Requires company GUID in URL path.

platforms.name: Personio
platforms.extraction_method: Official Public XML Job Feed (https://{slug}.jobs.personio.de/xml?language=en)

verification_evidence.notes: Verified live against https://personio-gmbh.jobs.personio.de/ (3 normalized jobs).

platforms.known_limitations: XML feed can be disabled by individual employers in Personio Career Page settings.

platforms.name: Phenom People
platforms.discovery_method: Embedded phApp.ddo script signature on enterprise career sites
platforms.extraction_method: Phenom People /widgets POST API (eagerLoadRefineSearch) or phApp.ddo hydration JSON
platforms.auth_requirements: Session CSRF token from career site HTML
platforms.known_limitations: Almost always deployed on custom enterprise domains; requires HTML signature discovery.

platforms.name: Pinpoint
platforms.extraction_method: Official Public JSON Feed (https://{slug}.pinpointhq.com/postings.json)

verification_evidence.notes: Verified live against https://ardentprinciples.pinpointhq.com/ (20 normalized jobs).

platforms.known_limitations: Custom career domains map back to {tenant}.pinpointhq.com/postings.json when Pinpoint JSON feed is enabled.

platforms.name: Polymer
platforms.extraction_method: Official Public Organization Jobs JSON API (https://api.polymer.co/v1/hire/organizations/{slug}/jobs)

verification_evidence.notes: Verified live against https://jobs.polymer.co/lighten (2 normalized jobs).

platforms.known_limitations: List endpoint returns structured metadata; connector fetches job detail JSON-LD when full HTML description is needed.

platforms.name: Recooty
platforms.extraction_method: Public career page HTML + JSON-LD
platforms.known_limitations: No documented unauthenticated JSON API.

platforms.name: Recruitee
platforms.extraction_method: Official Public Careers API (https://{slug}.recruitee.com/api/offers/)

verification_evidence.notes: Verified live against https://reploidgroupag.recruitee.com/ (20 normalized jobs).

platforms.known_limitations: Returns all published offers including HTML descriptions, salary ranges, and multi-location metadata.

platforms.name: Rippling
platforms.extraction_method: Rippling ATS public board API / Cloudflare-protected Next.js page
platforms.auth_requirements: None, but Cloudflare Bot Fight Mode blocks non-browser TLS fingerprints
platforms.known_limitations: ats.rippling.com enforces Cloudflare JS challenge (HTTP 403) against standard HTTP clients; compliant integration requires official Rippling Recruiting API token.

platforms.name: Rival
platforms.discovery_method: Rival HR / SilkRoad Recruiting career portals (*.silkroad.com)
platforms.extraction_method: SilkRoad / Rival OpenHire XML feed or career portal HTML
platforms.known_limitations: Legacy SilkRoad OpenHire portals use varied tenant URL schemes.

platforms.name: SAP SuccessFactors
platforms.discovery_method: Hostname career*.successfactors.com / career*.successfactors.eu or RMK sitemaps
platforms.extraction_method: Recruiting Marketing (RMK) XML Sitemap + HTML/JSON-LD job pages
platforms.auth_requirements: None for public RMK career sites; OData API requires customer credentials
platforms.known_limitations: Direct OData v2 JobRequisition API requires enterprise authentication; public indexing uses RMK search/sitemaps.

platforms.name: SmartRecruiters
platforms.extraction_method: Official Public Posting API v1 (https://api.smartrecruiters.com/v1/companies/{slug}/postings)

verification_evidence.notes: Verified live against https://careers.smartrecruiters.com/BoschGroup (15 normalized jobs).

platforms.known_limitations: List endpoint returns metadata; full HTML jobAd sections require /postings/{id} detail request (connector batches concurrent detail fetches responsibly).

platforms.name: Taleo
platforms.extraction_method: Oracle Taleo Career Section RSS feed orftlinterface JSON POST
platforms.known_limitations: Legacy JSF/FTL state tokens required when RSS feed is disabled.

platforms.name: Teamtailor
platforms.discovery_method: Subdomain *.teamtailor.com or Teamtailor RSS / meta tags
platforms.extraction_method: Official Public RSS 2.0 Feed (/jobs.rss with xmlns:tt location & department metadata)
platforms.auth_requirements: None for public /jobs.rss feed (REST API requires customer token)

verification_evidence.notes: Verified live against https://career.teamtailor.com/jobs (20 normalized jobs).

platforms.known_limitations: Public RSS caps feed size on massive enterprise boards unless REST API key is supplied.

platforms.name: Trakstar
platforms.extraction_method: Public Career Portal HTML + schema.org JobPosting JSON-LD detail extraction

verification_evidence.notes: Verified live against https://whatfix101.hire.trakstar.com/ (15 normalized jobs).

platforms.known_limitations: Formerly Recruiterbox; detail pages embed clean schema.org JobPosting JSON-LD.

platforms.name: TriNet
platforms.extraction_method: Public HTML career board extraction
platforms.known_limitations: Many TriNet PEO clients embed JazzHR or Greenhouse boards directly.

platforms.name: UltiPro
platforms.extraction_method: UKG Pro / UltiPro LoadSearchResults JSON POST endpoint
platforms.auth_requirements: None for public UKG job boards
platforms.known_limitations: Requires tenant code and JobBoard GUID in path.

platforms.name: WeRecruit
platforms.discovery_method: French ATS URL jobs.werecruit.io/{slug} or app.werecruit.io
platforms.extraction_method: Public career portal HTML / JSON-LD
platforms.known_limitations: Primarily French-language postings requiring French employment type mapping (CDI, CDD, Stage, Alternance).

platforms.name: Workable
platforms.extraction_method: Public v3 Accounts Jobs JSON API (POST https://apply.workable.com/api/v3/accounts/{slug}/jobs + v2 detail)

verification_evidence.notes: Verified live against https://apply.workable.com/credence (100 normalized jobs).

platforms.known_limitations: Cursor-based nextPage token pagination; detail description fetched per shortcode via /api/v2/accounts/{slug}/jobs/{shortcode}.

platforms.name: Workday
platforms.extraction_method: Workday Candidate Experience CXS JSON API (POST /wday/cxs/{tenant}/{site}/jobs + GET detail)

verification_evidence.notes: Verified live against https://salesforce.wd12.myworkdayjobs.com/External_Career_Site (15 normalized jobs).

platforms.known_limitations: Weekly Saturday maintenance windows redirect wd1/wd5 clusters to community.workday.com/maintenance-page (handled safely as transient retryable error).

platforms.name: Zoho Recruit
platforms.extraction_method: Zoho Recruit Career Site JSON/RSS feed or HTML portal
platforms.auth_requirements: None for public career portals; REST API requires OAuth2
platforms.known_limitations: Regional data centers (.com, .eu, .in, .com.au) use separate domains.

platforms.name: iCIMS
platforms.extraction_method: Public iframe search mode (?in_iframe=1&pr={page}) + detail JobPosting JSON-LD
platforms.known_limitations: Requires ?in_iframe=1 query flag on legacy portals to render actual HTML links rather than outer wrapper frame.

platforms.name: iSolvedHire
platforms.extraction_method: Public HTML listing + RSS/JSON-LD extraction
platforms.known_limitations: Cloudflare rate limiting on rapid detail page fetches.

platforms.name: talentReef
platforms.discovery_method: Hostname *.talentreef.com or Mitratech TalentReef hourly portals
platforms.extraction_method: TalentReef public job board API / SPA portal
platforms.known_limitations: High-volume hourly location-based requisitions require geo/store filtering.

platforms.name: Artha
platforms.discovery_method: Artha Job Board Software attribution / script markers
platforms.extraction_method: Public HTML / RSS feed + JSON-LD extraction
platforms.known_limitations: White-label deployments vary in URL slug conventions.

platforms.name: CareerSiteCloud
platforms.discovery_method: CareerSiteCloud recruitment agency / job board footer & CSS signatures
platforms.extraction_method: Public HTML listing + JSON-LD JobPosting
platforms.known_limitations: UK recruitment agency white-label deployments require HTML signature detection.

platforms.name: JBoard.io
platforms.extraction_method: JBoard Public HTML/RSS feed or REST API (requires operator API key for private API)
platforms.auth_requirements: None for public HTML/XML; Bearer key for JBoard admin REST API
platforms.known_limitations: REST API is authenticated per board owner; public indexing uses public board pages/feeds.

platforms.name: JobBoard.com
platforms.extraction_method: Public RSS/XML feed or HTML + JSON-LD
platforms.known_limitations: White-label custom domains.

platforms.name: JobBoard.io
platforms.discovery_method: Footer 'powered by JobBoard.io' or standard /jobs.rss Atom/RSS 2.0 feed
platforms.extraction_method: Official Public RSS 2.0 Job Feed ({board_origin}/jobs.rss)

verification_evidence.notes: Verified live against https://www.cancercareers.org/jobs.rss (20 normalized jobs).

platforms.known_limitations: HTML /jobs pages on some custom domains sit behind Cloudflare challenges, whereas /jobs.rss remains publicly accessible.

platforms.name: JobBoardFire
platforms.extraction_method: Public HTML + JSON-LD extraction
platforms.known_limitations: Custom domains require HTML signature discovery.

platforms.name: JobKit
platforms.discovery_method: JobKit footer attribution / asset bundle signature
platforms.extraction_method: Public HTML / JSON-LD job listing extraction
platforms.known_limitations: Custom domain deployments require HTML signature matching.

platforms.name: JobMount
platforms.discovery_method: Footer 'Job board software by JobMount' signature
platforms.extraction_method: Public HTML / XML sitemap + JSON-LD extraction
platforms.known_limitations: Custom templates per client deployment.

platforms.name: Jobboardly
platforms.discovery_method: Subdomain *.jobboardly.com or 'Powered by Jobboardly' / Jobboardly DOM structure
platforms.extraction_method: Public /jobs/ index + detail schema.org JobPosting JSON-LD extraction

verification_evidence.notes: Verified live against https://etcareers.com/ (8 normalized jobs).

platforms.known_limitations: Boards configured with Jobboardly Paywall restrict full application links to subscribed seekers.

platforms.name: Jobiqo
platforms.discovery_method: Jobiqo media/association career board meta & CSS signatures
platforms.extraction_method: Public RSS feed / Sitemap + schema.org JobPosting JSON-LD
platforms.known_limitations: Enterprise publishing boards run exclusively on custom publisher domains.

platforms.name: Niceboard
platforms.discovery_method: Footer 'Powered by Niceboard', /sitemap-jobs.xml, or Niceboard initial_filters script signature
platforms.extraction_method: Niceboard Public AJAX JSON API (GET /api/jobs with filter parameters & pagination)
platforms.auth_requirements: None for public job boards (unless paid seeker paywall is enabled by operator)

verification_evidence.notes: Verified live against https://jobs.exitfive.com/ (17 normalized jobs).

platforms.known_limitations: Some Niceboard operators enable paid jobseeker login walls restricting apply_url visibility.

platforms.name: Nodex
platforms.discovery_method: Nodex job board software meta & asset signatures
platforms.extraction_method: Public HTML + schema.org JobPosting JSON-LD
platforms.known_limitations: Custom domain deployments require DOM inspection.

platforms.name: SmartJobBoard
platforms.extraction_method: Public HTML listing (/job/{id}/{slug}/) + detail JobPosting JSON-LD & structured metadata extraction
platforms.auth_requirements: None for public boards (REST API requires operator key)

verification_evidence.notes: Verified live against https://master.mysmartjobboard.net/ (4 normalized jobs).

platforms.known_limitations: Nginx blocks unauthenticated /rss/ on some SmartJobBoard instances; HTML + detail extraction succeeds reliably.

platforms.name: Talenetic
platforms.discovery_method: Talenetic career site & niche job board signatures
platforms.extraction_method: Public XML/RSS feed or HTML + JSON-LD extraction
platforms.known_limitations: Deployed primarily on white-labeled enterprise and media domains.

platforms.name: WP Job Manager
platforms.discovery_method: WordPress /wp-json/wp/v2/job-listings route or wp-content/plugins/wp-job-manager asset signature
platforms.extraction_method: WordPress REST API v2 (/wp-json/wp/v2/job-listings) with fallback to /jm-ajax/get_listings and RSS job_feed

verification_evidence.example_source_name: Cycle-Jobs Cycling Industry Board (WP Job Manager)
verification_evidence.notes: Verified live against https://cycle-jobs.com/ (15 normalized jobs).

platforms.known_limitations: Site owners may disable WP REST API via security plugins; fallback RSS (?feed=job_feed) or AJAX endpoint covers disabled REST setups.

platforms.name: Wiley Madgex
platforms.discovery_method: Wiley Job Network / Madgex '/jobsrss/' & 'Madgex' meta/asset signatures
platforms.extraction_method: Madgex /jobsrss/ XML feed or paginated /jobs/ HTML + JSON-LD
platforms.auth_requirements: None, subject to AWS WAF bot challenges on select domains
platforms.known_limitations: AWS WAF returns HTTP 202 empty challenge responses on direct automated hits to wileyjobnetwork.com without browser token.

platforms.name: eJobBoard
platforms.extraction_method: Public HTML job board extraction
platforms.known_limitations: Legacy white-label job board templates.

platforms.name: ejobsitesoftware.com
platforms.extraction_method: Public RSS/XML feed or HTML listing
platforms.known_limitations: Self-hosted deployments with customized PHP URL routes.

platforms.name: jobBoardHQ
platforms.extraction_method: Public HTML / Atom feed extraction
platforms.known_limitations: Small niche board install base.

platforms.name: jobboardsoftware.com
platforms.extraction_method: Public HTML listing + JSON-LD
platforms.known_limitations: Self-hosted / white-label PHP/SaaS installations.
